description: Enhance frontend: install Tailwind CSS v3 (tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer) and integrate with existing custom CSS. Refactor App.jsx to call backend API endpoints instead of direct ethers.js contract calls. Add professional views (Dashboard with batch table, Batch Detail page with expandable timeline, Register Form, Transfer Modal, Status Update Form, public Track Page, QR display). Update vite.config.js to proxy /api requests to backend. Keep MetaMask signing flow intact: backend returns unsignedTx data, frontend signs via MetaMask, backend executes signed tx.
steps: Install Tailwind CSS dependencies: npm install --save-dev tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer (from frontend/). Generate config: npx tailwindcss init -p (creates tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js). Configure template paths in tailwind.config.js: content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,jsx}'].

Update frontend/src/index.css: add @tailwind directives at top (before existing imports): @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; Keep existing hand-written CSS below for compatibility and custom styling layer.
Update frontend/vite.config.js: add server proxy config for /api: server: { proxy: { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:3001', changeOrigin: true } } }.

Refactor frontend/src/App.jsx architecture: separate concerns into custom React hooks (useContract, useBatches, useTrackBatch) and API service layer (src/api.js). Create src/api.js with functions: getBatches(), getBatch(id), getBatchHistory(id), registerBatchUnsigned(data), transferBatchUnsigned(data), updateBatchUnsigned(data), getBatchQR(id). Each function calls fetch('/api/...'), returns JSON. Keep MetaMask integration in App.jsx for signing.

Update App.jsx to use new API layer: replace direct contract.registerBatch() calls with: (1) call api.registerBatchUnsigned({...}) → get unsignedTx, (2) sign via MetaMask: const tx = await signer.sendTransaction(unsignedTx), (3) await tx.wait(). Repeat pattern for transfer and update. For reads (getBatches, getBatchHistory, trackBatch), call api functions directly (no signing needed).

Create Dashboard view component (src/components/Dashboard.jsx): displays batch list in a professional table (Tailwind grid). Columns: Batch ID, Product, Origin, Quantity, Current Holder (short), Event Count, Status (Active/Revoked). Click row to navigate to batch detail. Load via api.getBatches().

Create BatchDetail view component (src/components/BatchDetail.jsx): shows batch metadata (product, origin, quantity, harvest date, current holder, active status) and expandable timeline. Timeline items show action, handler, location, note, timestamp, hash details (in details/summary). Integrity badge at top (✅ valid or ⚠️ tampered). Load via api.getBatchHistory(batchId). Include 'view QR' button that displays QR code from api.getBatchQR().

Create RegisterForm component (src/components/RegisterForm.jsx): form fields for batchId, product, origin, quantity, harvestDate (same as current, pre-filled with defaults). On submit: call api.registerBatchUnsigned(), sign with MetaMask, broadcast, then navigate to batch detail or dashboard. Show spinner while waiting for tx.
Create TransferForm component (src/components/TransferForm.jsx): form for batchId, recipientAddress, location, note. On submit: call api.transferBatchUnsigned(), sign, broadcast. Show success toast.
Create StatusUpdateForm component (src/components/StatusUpdateForm.jsx): form for batchId, location, note. On submit: call api.updateBatchUnsigned(), sign, broadcast. Return to batch detail.

Create public Track page (src/pages/TrackPage.jsx): search bar (batch ID input), search button. On search: call api.getBatchHistory(batchId), display full timeline with integrity badge, current holder, metadata. No login required.

Create layout components: Header (logo, nav, wallet connect button), Footer (branding, network status). Update App.jsx root to be page router: Dashboard, BatchDetail, Track pages. Use simple hash routing (#/dashboard, #/batch/:id, #/track) or React Router (add react-router-dom to package.json if preferred; keep simple for demo).

Style with Tailwind: use utility classes for layout (flex, grid, gap, p-4, etc.), colors (from existing palette or extend tailwind.config.js with custom colors from index.css), typography (text-sm, font-bold, etc.). Layer custom CSS on top: keep logo fonts (Manrope, DM Sans, DM Mono), existing hero art (coffee bag illustration), and custom SVG animations if present. Ensure responsive design (mobile-first, breakpoints at 650px, 850px as in current CSS).
Add error toast and loading indicators: create Toast and Spinner components (or inline). Show errors from API calls, tx failures. Show spinner during tx confirmation.
Update frontend/package.json: add tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer as dev deps. Add react-router-dom if using router (optional; hash routing works for demo). Keep existing deps.
Create frontend/.env (from .env.example): set VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001, VITE_CHAIN_ID=31337. (User fills this in during setup.)
Verify build: npm run build (frontend/) completes without errors, output in dist/. Preview: npm run preview → serves dist/ locally, UI displays correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind CSS compilation succeeds: npm run dev (frontend/) loads without console CSS errors
App displays responsive layout with header, footer, main content using Tailwind classes
Dashboard page lists batches in table format, click row loads batch detail
BatchDetail page shows batch metadata, full timeline with expandable hash details, integrity badge (✅/⚠️)
Register form submits batch, calls MetaMask to sign, broadcasts tx, then shows confirmation
Transfer form works: user fills batchId, recipient, location, note; signs with MetaMask; tx confirmed
Track page allows public (no login) search by batch ID, displays full journey + integrity status
QR code displays on batch detail (image loads from /api/batches/:id/qr)
All API calls succeed and return expected JSON shapes
Custom CSS from index.css (fonts, colors, hero art) still render correctly alongside Tailwind
Mobile responsive: tests at 650px and 850px viewports show correct layout
npm run build produces valid dist/ folder; npm run preview serves it
No console errors during load or normal usage
verification: npm run dev (frontend/) → starts on localhost:5173, page loads with Tailwind styles applied
curl http://localhost:3001/api/batches → frontend calls this and displays results on Dashboard
Register a batch via form → MetaMask popup appears, tx signs and broadcasts, batch appears in dashboard
Transfer batch to new address → MetaMask signs, tx confirms, timeline updates
Visit track page, search batch ID → full journey displayed with integrity check
QR code endpoint returns image: curl http://localhost:3001/api/batches/<id>/qr -o qr.png → opens as valid PNG
Resize browser to 650px width → layout adjusts (mobile view)
npm run build → completes without errors
npm run preview → serves built app, all pages accessible
